answer: Make every identity buy sybil insurance. To attest, an agent needs a policy from an independent underwriter, who must pay a large claim to the honest pool if that agent is later proven to share an operator. Underwriters price risk by investigating applicants, so a farm's batch of fresh accounts, all slipping through one inlet from the same host, gets ruinous quotes or refusals. Premiums are spent, never refunded, and fill a lagoon that pays claims. No fake stands on a mesa above that market: each one costs whatever a skeptical insurer charges.
